title: A view is not a document
summary: Each page and each component has a view (an HTML template). The `tac.html` of a page places components. The `tac.html` of each component defines its content. The compiler creates the document around them. If a view contains a doctype, `<html>`, `<head>` or `<body>`, the build fails with `TY1307`. Tachyon cannot merge a head that you write with the head that it generates.
